D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IAEXERC ITVS

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, possibly Lyon mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXERC ITVS. In exergue: U [with pellet] PL. Diameter: 17mm, Weight: 2.36gms, die axis: 6
